title: Effective Study Habits
content: Compiled a list of effective study habits that can help students manage their time better and reduce stress. These include the Pomodoro Technique, which involves working for 25 minutes followed by a 5-minute break, active recall, which is the practice of testing oneself on the material to be learned, and spaced repetition, a technique that involves spreading out study sessions over time to improve long-term retention.

title: Emily Turner's Assessment
content: Completed a detailed assessment of Emily Turner's stress levels and coping mechanisms. Identified key stressors in her academic and personal life, including upcoming exams and her extracurricular commitments. Developed a personalized plan to help her manage academic pressure, which includes a structured study schedule using the Pomodoro Technique, regular mindfulness sessions, and a balanced approach to her extracurricular activities. Provided resources for tutoring in Mathematics and Science to bolster her confidence in these subjects. Scheduled follow-up sessions to monitor progress and make adjustments as needed.
